description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveEntitlementModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave API module. The class models a leave entitlement data structure for API serialization, including properties like employee info, leave type, entitlement, usage, and date fields. It implements normalization via traits, uses annotations for API schema documentation, and constructs mappings for entity attributes.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing leave entitlement data for API responses, mapping entity attributes to API schema properties, using traits for normalization, and annotations for OpenAPI documentation.
